NEX-LED - Professional, Rechargeable - Color Match Light

The NextLED Professional, Rechargeable Color Match Light is a CRI 96+ handheld rechargeable LED work light that is perfect for accurate color matching and identifying imperfections before and after paint repairs. By replicating natural sunlight, you can perfectly match paint colors, clearly evaluate damaged areas, and identify paint defects such as swirl marks and sanding scratches. It features 3 different color temperatures: 2700K, 4000K, and 6500K at a maximum 500 lumen brightness. The head lamp tilts up to 180 degrees and includes a fold-out swivel hanging hook, a built-in magnet, an LED battery status indicator and a charging station base that can be wall-mounted.

[NT-7885M | Professional Rechargeable Color Match Inspection Work Light] — Section: How this differs from similar NextLED lights
The nearest sibling is the NT-6692M, the other ULTIMATE color matching light. The NT-7885M is the brighter inspection tool, rated CRI 95 plus with two color temperatures at 6500 K and 3000 K, a flood up to 1500 lm in Turbo, an SMD spot, a UV light, and a magnetic pick up tip, with IP66 and IK07 ratings. The NT-6692M is rated CRI 96 plus and offers five color temperatures at 2700 K, 3500 K, 4500 K, 5500 K, and 6500 K with a memory function, but at a lower 500 lm flood and 200 lm spot and an IPX6 rating. Choose the NT-7885M for maximum brightness and inspection features, and the NT-6692M when you want more color temperature steps for fine matching. Both are ULTIMATE and carry a 3 year warranty.

[NT-W2301 | Folding Rechargeable Slim Bar LED Work Light] — Section: What it is
The NextLED NT-W2301 is a slim, rechargeable LED work light built to slide into tight places like engine bays and narrow gaps. It gives you a wide flood for filling an area with light plus a focused spot on the end of the bar. A magnetic base and a swiveling, rotating bar let you set it down and work hands free. It is a compact task light, so it is not meant to replace a large tripod work light for lighting a whole bay.

chunks.product_name: NextLED Company and Policies
chunks.text:
[NextLED Company and Policies] — Section: About NextLED
NextLED is a brand of Nextool Inc. that offers battery operated and rechargeable LED lighting in three areas, Automotive, Home, and Construction Job Site. The company has provided value and innovation for distributors and customers since 2009. Its global headquarters in Schaumburg, Illinois includes Marketing, Product Management, Engineering, Research and Development, and Customer Support. The team focuses on understanding users and innovating on new and existing LED solutions, and integrity, quality, and workmanship go into every product.

chunks.product_name: NextLED Company and Policies
chunks.text:
[NextLED Company and Policies] — Section: Warranty terms
NextLED provides a 1 year warranty on most products. The ULTIMATE series carries a 3 year warranty. The ULTIMATE series is exactly three models, the NT-6692M, the NT-7885M, and the NT-6926M. Every other NextLED product carries the standard 1 year warranty. This limited warranty covers defects in material or damage on arrival.

chunks.product_name: NextLED Company and Policies
chunks.section: Authorized retailers versus third party sellers
chunks.text:
[NextLED Company and Policies] — Section: Authorized retailers versus third party sellers
The limited warranty covers only customers who purchase NextLED products directly from mynextled.com or from authorized retailers or resellers. If you purchased from a third party seller, please contact that seller directly, because NextLED cannot provide a refund for those purchases. The limited warranty does not apply to products bought from unauthorized resellers, and NextLED is not responsible for refund or replacement of those products. To make a warranty claim you must have your original receipt of purchase.

chunks.product_name: NextLED Company and Policies
chunks.text:
[NextLED Company and Policies] — Section: Returns and refunds
NextLED accepts returns for refund when the request is made within 14 days of purchase, with the original receipt, and when the product was purchased directly from mynextled.com. A customer may receive a replacement beyond 14 days if the issue is a warranty or defective product matter. A customer who returns a product within the window due to buyer's remorse is responsible for all return shipping costs. A customer who receives a defective item gets a return shipping label and is not responsible for return shipping.

[NextLED Company and Policies] — Section: Charging troubleshooting for NT-2143C-B and NT-5571
This guidance applies to the NT-2143C-B motion sensing detailing headlamp and the NT-5571 drop light. If either light will not charge, use this guidance.

This light can fail to charge if it is connected to an adapter that is too powerful. Do not use an adapter rated over 3 amps or 8 volts, because that can trip the battery's overcharge protection and prevent it from charging. Use a standard 5V USB charger with the supplied cable.

[NextLED Product Index and Comparison] — Section: Common questions
**Which NextLED light is best for color matching?**
The color match lights are the NT-7885M, NT-6692M, NT-2040B-3, NT-1010UV, NT-R3202, NT-V3505, NT-6615K, and NT-2143C-B. For critical color matching, the two ULTIMATE choices stand out. Pick the NT-6692M for the most color temperatures, five at CRI 96 plus with a memory function, or the NT-7885M for the brightest inspection at CRI 95 plus and up to 1500 lm.

[NextLED Product Index and Comparison] — Section: Common questions
**Which NextLED light is the brightest?**
The NT-6926M is the brightest at 6000 lm on high. Among the color match lights the NT-1010UV reaches 2000 lm and the NT-7885M reaches 1500 lm in Turbo.

[NextLED Product Index and Comparison] — Section: Common questions
**Which NextLED light works under a car?**
The NT-6648, the 10 inch triple light mode under car work light, rolls under a car on steel wheels with a disc flood, a flexible detail arm, and a UV mode.

[NextLED Product Index and Comparison] — Section: Common questions
**Which NextLED lights fit in a pocket?**
The pen lights NT-6615 and NT-6615K, the NT-6786 pocket task light, the NT-6685 pocket work light, and the NT-6788 keychain light are all pocket sized.

[NextLED Product Index and Comparison] — Section: Common questions
**Which NextLED lights have a UV light?**
The NT-6615, NT-6615K, NT-2061A-10UV, NT-6648, NT-7885M, NT-1010UV, and NT-2220LF-UV all include a UV mode.

[NextLED Product Index and Comparison] — Section: Common questions
**Which are the ULTIMATE models?**
The ULTIMATE models are the NT-6692M, the NT-7885M, and the NT-6926M. They carry a 3 year warranty, while all other products carry a 1 year warranty.
